note: Board and go (brief 018 §5), the twin of route-a-pressure: the same route to the ambush; then the Enforcer walks Vale to the car as it springs, the three fire until the blocker is down, then board, and the car leaves with the whole cell. Route A with Pressure for Help (Keel S25; Sky Q4): Pressure leans on her affair, learned by Listen ($0, +3 T, no step worse whatever her temperament: Motive, motive-lovers.md); the r016 cast's Inez is Fearful, so Pressure is also her own approach and one order turns her; the rest is route A. The cell runs where a player in a hurry would (to the café, the cabinet and the door): a run is noticed (Alert 1 at most), which the quiet route can afford.

steps.why: to the café terrace, where Inez can be watched
to wait by the service end of the west face (Sky's door option (b), 2026-10-19), 5.6 m south of the public door and out of the guard's cone, which looks west over the forecourt

steps.label: reroute
steps.why: the idle Tech sends the patrol off its sweep, so the entry needn't wait for a gap

steps.label: enter
steps.why: the first moment the door is unwatched: guard away, camera looped, patrol off its sweep
back to the getaway car to cover the extraction
the loop is no longer needed once the Enforcer is inside

steps.label: hold
steps.why: out of the service door with Vale, to a point 19.5 m south-east of the car, off the rivals' posts by the planters: the ambush springs at 20 m, and the Enforcer holds there while the cell fights
the ambush: the armed cell fires at will

steps.label: out
steps.why: board and go (brief 018 §5): the ambush springs, and the Enforcer walks Vale straight to the car while the three fire; he cannot run or fire
the three cover the Enforcer until he is in and the blocker is down, then go to the car (they board last, brief 018 §2)
once the last board lands (1 s), the whole cell in the car and the car free: it leaves with nobody behind
